h1: Custom Gildan Outerwear for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom Gildan outerwear in bulk for your team. Perfect Imprints offers reliable branding on hoodies, sweatshirts, and more.
introHtml: Gildan outerwear is a trusted choice for bulk corporate orders because of its consistent sizing, durable cotton-poly blends, and wide range of styles from hoodies to crewnecks. Whether you need embroidered logos on Heavy Blend hoodies for a safety crew or screen-printed crewnecks for a company giveaway, Gildan's reliable construction holds up to frequent wear and washing. Perfect for marketing directors equipping field teams or HR directors outfitting new hires.
heroAltText: Custom Gildan outerwear including hoodies and crewnecks with embroidered logos for corporate teams
